CATALOG.SUBTITLE: Products, services and subscription plans you sell, used in quotes, invoices and subscriptions.
CATALOG.SEARCH: Search by name, code or description
CATALOG.NAME: Name
CATALOG.PRICE_HELP: Leave blank when it is quoted, measured or made to order.
CATALOG.CREATED_ADD_IMAGES: Item created. You can add images now.
CATALOG.BILLING_HELP: A plan for subscriptions: the price is charged automatically every month or year. It needs a price.

CATEGORIES.TITLE: Categories
CATEGORIES.DESCRIPTION: Rename a category by editing its name. Items of a deleted category stay without a category.

COMPANY.DESCRIPTION: The details printed on your quotes, invoices and receipts, online payments and the payment methods you accept.

ONLINE.TITLE: Online payments
ONLINE.DESCRIPTION: Let customers pay invoices online, in full or in part. The payment is recorded and the receipt is sent automatically.
ONLINE.HOW_TO: To show the Pay button on invoices, link a payment method below to a provider, and keep that method checked on the invoice.

KEY_HELP.stripe: Stripe Dashboard, Developers, API keys. Use the secret key (not the publishable one), or a restricted key with write access to Checkout Sessions and Webhook Endpoints. The key is stored encrypted and the payment webhook is created for you.
KEY_HELP.mercado_pago: Mercado Pago Developers, Your integrations, your application, Production credentials (or test credentials). Paste the Access token (not the Public key). Only Mercado Pago Brasil accounts (BRL) are accepted. Customers pay by card, Pix, boleto or Mercado Pago balance.
KEY_HELP.yappy: Yappy Comercial, Botón de Pago. Paste the Merchant ID and the Secret key, and register {url} (or the domain you type below) as the payment domain. Customers type their Yappy phone on the invoice and approve the payment in the Yappy app. USD only.

ONLINE.WEBHOOK_SECRET_HELP: Optional extra check. In Your integrations, Webhooks, set the webhook URL shown on the Mercado Pago card with the Payments event and paste the secret signature here. Without it, every notice is still confirmed by reading the payment from Mercado Pago.
ONLINE.WEBHOOK_SUBSCRIPTIONS: For subscriptions, register this URL in Mercado Pago (Your integrations, your application, Webhooks, production mode) with the events Payments and Plans and subscriptions. Without it, subscription charges are not recorded here.
ONLINE.NO_METHOD: No active payment method uses {provider} yet, so invoices show no Pay button. Edit a payment method below and pick {provider} in Online charge.

PAYMENT_METHODS.TITLE: Payment methods
PAYMENT_METHODS.DESCRIPTION: What you accept and what the customer needs to pay you (bank details, Pix key, Yappy number…).
PAYMENT_METHODS.NAME: Name
PAYMENT_METHODS.INSTRUCTIONS_PLACEHOLDER: Account number, Pix key, Yappy number…
PAYMENT_METHODS.DELETE_DESCRIPTION: It disappears from the company settings and from every quote and invoice that shows it.
PAYMENT_METHODS.DELETE_IN_USE: This payment method already has payments or online charges, so it stays in the history. Uncheck Active to hide it.

DOCUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Create quotes and invoices with your branding, send them by chat or email, get paid online and send receipts.
DOCUMENTS.SEARCH_CONTACT: Search a contact to fill in
DOCUMENTS.NO_LINES: No items yet. Add from the catalog or a free line.
DOCUMENTS.NO_PDFS: No PDF generated yet. Every generated PDF is kept here.
DOCUMENTS.NO_CONVERSATIONS: This customer has no conversation yet. Pick a contact on the document or send by email.
DOCUMENTS.MESSAGE_PLACEHOLDER: Leave blank to use the default text in the document language
DOCUMENTS.PAYMENT_METHODS_SHOWN: Payment methods shown on this document

SUBSCRIPTIONS.DESCRIPTION: Monthly and yearly plans charged automatically by the payment provider. Each paid cycle becomes a paid invoice, and the receipt goes to the customer.
SUBSCRIPTIONS.PAYMENT_METHOD_HELP: Only payment methods charged online by a provider that bills subscriptions: Stripe (USD, EUR, BRL) or Mercado Pago (BRL).
SUBSCRIPTIONS.NO_PLANS: No plans in the catalog yet. Create an item with Billing set to Monthly or Yearly plan.
SUBSCRIPTIONS.NO_ONLINE_METHODS: No payment method linked to Stripe or Mercado Pago. Link one in Company & payments.
SUBSCRIPTIONS.LINK_HELP: Send this link to the customer. They subscribe on the payment provider's page, and the first charge happens right away.
